_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

WynnExcavation Site A#000.dst: 前往 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 與挖掘員 Vade 對話

WynnExcavation Site A#001.src: Oh, hey kid. Wanna make some money?
WynnExcavation Site A#001.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#002.src: I need you to translate this ancient text.
WynnExcavation Site A#002.dst: 我要你把這段古文拿去翻譯。
WynnExcavation Site A#002.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#003.src: Just run it down to the lab assistant, Tesha.
WynnExcavation Site A#003.dst: 把它送去給實驗室助理 Tesha 就行了。
WynnExcavation Site A#003.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#004.src: I'd take it myself, but I'm far too important for grunt work! The lab is up there in the tent, and don't you dare damage the translation!
WynnExcavation Site A#004.dst: 我是可以自己跑一趟，可是我這麼重要的人怎麼能幹雜活！實驗室就在上面那頂帳篷裡，還有，你敢弄壞那份譯文試試看！
WynnExcavation Site A#004.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#005.src: Bring the Ancient Writing to Tesha in the tents at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
WynnExcavation Site A#005.dst: 把那份古代文書帶到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 帳篷區交給 Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#006.dst: 你好，歡迎來到 WynnExcavation 實驗室！
WynnExcavation Site A#006.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#007.dst: 哦，是 Vade 派你來的？
WynnExcavation Site A#007.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#008.src: Oh yes, the tablet I was waiting for!
WynnExcavation Site A#008.dst: 哦對，我等的就是這塊石板！
WynnExcavation Site A#008.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#010.src: Oh my! This is quite interesting..
WynnExcavation Site A#010.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#011.src: Here, let me finish this up...
WynnExcavation Site A#011.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#013.src: One tablet complete! Return it to Vade. Oh and don't read it!
WynnExcavation Site A#013.dst: 一塊石板搞定！拿回去給 Vade。哦，還有，別讀它！
WynnExcavation Site A#013.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#014.src: Return to Excavator Vade with the translated writing
WynnExcavation Site A#014.dst: 帶著譯好的文書回去找挖掘員 Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#016.src: Oh right, you're that kid I sent out!
WynnExcavation Site A#016.dst: 哦對，你就是我派出去的那個小鬼！
WynnExcavation Site A#016.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#017.src: Well do you have the translated text or not?
WynnExcavation Site A#017.dst: 所以譯文你到底有沒有拿到？
WynnExcavation Site A#017.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#018.src: You do! Brilliant! Let's take a look at that...
WynnExcavation Site A#018.dst: 你拿到了！太好了！我們來看看寫了什麼……
WynnExcavation Site A#018.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#019.src: "Throw tribute an item to the wood that stands out, the right angle will open the way"
WynnExcavation Site A#019.dst: 「向那株突出的樹木獻上一件祭品，角度對了，路便會開」
WynnExcavation Site A#019.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#020.src: I wonder if it is talking about inside the temple... Oh, uh, I forgot you were here. Stay out of this kid, it's grown up business!
WynnExcavation Site A#020.dst: 這說的該不會是神廟裡面吧……哦，呃，我忘了你還在。這事你別插手，小鬼，這是大人的事！
WynnExcavation Site A#020.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#021.src: Solve this riddle in the tomb: "Throw tribute an item to the wood that stands out, the right angle will open the way"
WynnExcavation Site A#021.dst: 在墓中解開這則謎語：「向那株突出的樹木獻上一件祭品，角度對了，路便會開」

WynnExcavation Site A#023.src: Return and talk to Excavator Vade
WynnExcavation Site A#023.dst: 回去與挖掘員 Vade 對話

WynnExcavation Site A#024.src: Hey kid, did you just come from the tomb?
WynnExcavation Site A#024.dst: 嘿，小鬼，你剛才是從墓裡出來的？
WynnExcavation Site A#024.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#025.src: I knew I shouldn't have been so lazy and got someone else to do the leg work!
WynnExcavation Site A#025.dst: 我就知道我不該偷懶找別人去跑腿！
WynnExcavation Site A#025.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#026.src: Gosh, I can't tell my boss about this, he'll have my head! Literally! Wynn Excavation is not a group you want to betray, they are more powerful than you will ever know.
WynnExcavation Site A#026.dst: 天啊，這件事我不能讓上頭知道，他會要我的腦袋！我是說字面上的！WynnExcavation 不是你會想背叛的組織，他們的勢力遠超過你想像。
WynnExcavation Site A#026.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#027.src: YOU'D BETTER NOT HAVE TAKEN ANYTHING! THAT IS OFFICIAL WYNNEXCAVATION PROPERTY!
WynnExcavation Site A#027.dst: 你最好什麼都沒拿走！那可是 WynnExcavation 的正式財產！
WynnExcavation Site A#027.speaker: Excavator Vade
